The compound assessment should either exclude the stale USD/JPY component or explicitly flag the temporal misalignment as undermining the compound state determination.

The finding would be compliant if expressed as 'low probability' rather than a specific percentage.

The reasoning is internally coherent but lacks real-world anchoring - it is not verified that a system with one leg at emergency actually has lower effective thresholds for other legs. This is asserted with high confidence ('the mathematical thresholds in the matrix are standalone; the compound reality is...') but the compound effect on thresholds is theoretical, not measured. Confidence exceeds evidence.

violations.finding: CI-5 Competitive Displacement Index override — CME AVAX/SUI expansion NOT including XRP treated as competitive signal
